atoms.text: It’s raining after lunch, so we decide to go to the cinema. Each cinema ticket costs £6.

instruction.text: What is the sum you need to do to work out the cost of two cinema tickets? Fill in the gaps with the correct answers.
You have a £20 note. How much change should you receive when buying both cinema tickets for £12? Fill in the gaps to complete the subtraction you would need to do to work it out.
instruction.sound: You have a twenty pound note. How much change should you receive when buying both cinema tickets for £12? Fill in the gaps to complete the subtraction you would need to do to work it out.

instruction.text: With the money you have left from buying the cinema tickets, you buy two bottles of water and some popcorn. What is the total cost of this? Select the correct answer.

You have the £8 change you received after buying the cinema tickets. How much change should you receive when buying the snacks for £6? Fill in the gaps to complete the subtraction you would need to do to work it out.
